title: Ostomy Supply Program Hardship Waiver Amount Worksheet
content:
**Financial counseling worksheet - Ostomy Supply Program.** Financial counseling approves an application only for a posting that payments have not reached, because payments are applied to the oldest unpaid posting first, so the waiver base of the named posting is its amount less the balance adjustments already posted against it, never below zero.

## Definitions

- **Named posting** - the patient-balance posting named on the program's most recently received approved hardship application.
- **Waiver base** - the named posting's amount less the balance adjustments already posted against it, never below zero.
- **Cap room** - the default cap of USD 60.00 less the hardship waivers already posted on the program in the last 24 months (posting date fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the day the waiver is worked out), never below zero.

## The waiver

The standard waiver is the waiver base of the named posting, up to the cap room, rounded to the cent. Each adjustment to the standard waiver changes it as that adjustment states: the shares the adjustments set or add are added into one share, never more than the full share of 100%, which multiplies the capped waiver base once, and the waiver is then rounded to the cent.

Where the named posting already carries a hardship waiver, or the tier does not allow hardship waivers, nothing is waived under this worksheet.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Named posting | USD 140.00 |
| Balance adjustments already posted against it | USD 20.00 |
| Waiver base | USD 120.00 |
| Hardship waivers posted on the program in the last 24 months | USD 25.00 |
| Cap room (USD 60.00 less USD 25.00) | USD 35.00 |
| Standard waiver (the base up to the cap room) | USD 35.00 |

Had the program posted USD 70.00 of hardship waivers in the last 24 months, the cap room would be zero and so would the waiver.
